text.content:
Nobody has seen his face. Pacifica would die for him.

Role: Netrunner (Netrunner 10), leader of the Voodoo Boys
Affiliation: Voodoo Boys
Where to find them: Coastview, through runners, holograms and the radio
Known for: Organizing Pacifica's Haitian community since 2062

Nobody knows who Agwe is, but he lives up to the name of the loa of the sea. Since the 2062 storm he has led the netrunners who organize Pacifica's Haitian community, and he takes in anyone fleeing disaster or Barghest's reach. He has never been seen in person; some in Pacifica have died for him. He let the netrunner Ocelot leave the Voodoo Boys for Danger Gal's Puma Squad, which nobody else gets.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 05, 12
